lead: The Mediterranean climate, 9 kilometres of linear park, 20 km of beach and 160 km of cycle lanes make Valencia the ideal destination for playing sport all year round.

Valencia is much more than a city for watching sport. Its flat terrain, its network of cycle lanes, the Turia Gardens as a natural circuit and the Mediterranean on the doorstep make it a first-rate active destination. The Valencia Marathon, rated Platinum by World Athletics, is the marathon with the greatest television coverage in the world.
Whether you want to do sport during your visit or come to watch a big event, Valencia has a sporting agenda that never stops all year.

items.title: Running · Running City
items.body: Valencia is internationally recognised as the Running City. The Turia Gardens offer 9 kilometres of continuous track with no traffic lights or cars, ideal for running at any time. The city hosts more than 30 races a year, from popular 5Ks to the Valencia Marathon Trinidad Alfonso Zurich, the fastest 42 km race in the world.
facts: 9 km of continuous track, the city’s most popular urban circuit
A 4 km route along the seafront promenade with views of the Mediterranean
Dirt trails 25 km from the centre for running in nature
Free · Race registration depends on the event
All year · Best from October to May

items.title: Cycling and MTB
items.body: With more than 160 kilometres of cycle lanes and 40 cycle streets, Valencia is one of the most cycling-friendly cities in Spain. The Turia Gardens are the main axis, but the network extends across the whole city and connects with the country tracks of the Huerta and the mountain trails of the Sierra Calderona. Valenbisi bike hire is available at more than 250 stations.
facts: The most popular urban route: 9 km from the Bioparc to the CAC without interruption
More than 100 km of country tracks circling Valencia through the Huerta
Mountain trails with panoramic views of the Mediterranean 30 km away
160 km of cycle lanes · Turia Gardens · Huerta · Sierra Calderona

items.title: Watersports and sailing
items.body: La Marina de Valencia and its port infrastructure make the city one of the great watersports destinations of the Mediterranean. Sailing, windsurfing, kitesurfing, paddleboarding, kayaking and jet skis are just some of the activities available. Every year Valencia hosts world-class events such as Sail GP, the Queen’s Trophy and the 52 Super Series.
facts: Sailing clubs with beginner classes and boat hire
Routes around La Marina and the urban beaches with hire from €15/h
El Saler beach has the ideal wind conditions for this sport
Marina de Valencia · Marina · Malvarrosa beach

items.title: Surfing and beach sports
items.body: Valencia’s beaches allow surfing, bodyboarding, beach volleyball, beach padel and fitness on the sand for much of the year. The waves at Malvarrosa are ideal for beginners, while El Saler and the beaches south of Valencia offer more demanding conditions. Beach volleyball tournaments and beachbol championships are held in summer on the beach itself.
facts: Surf schools at Malvarrosa with equipment included from €30
Permanent courts at Malvarrosa, competitions in summer
Yoga, CrossFit and functional training classes at sunrise
Malvarrosa beach · El Saler · Gandia beach

items.title: Football · Valencia CF and Levante UD
items.body: Valencia has two teams with history and a loyal following. Valencia CF, with its legendary Mestalla stadium, and Levante UD, at the Estadio Ciutat de València. The Mestalla Forever Tour lets you visit the club’s facilities on non-match days. Both teams compete in the main competitions of Spanish football.
facts: Capacity for 49,430 spectators · Mestalla Forever Tour available every day
Capacity for 25,354 spectators in the north of the city
Guided visit to the dressing room, pitch and museum of Valencia CF · From €16
Estadio Mestalla (Valencia CF) · Estadio Ciutat de València (Levante UD)

items.title: Basketball · Valencia Basket
items.body: Valencia Basket is one of the most decorated basketball clubs in Spain, with multiple Liga Endesa titles and regular participation in the EuroLeague. The Roig Arena is the club’s new arena, with a capacity of more than 9,000 spectators and one of the best atmospheres in European basketball. The women’s section is also a continental powerhouse.
facts: The new arena with a capacity of more than 9,000 spectators
High-level international games throughout the season
One of the best women’s basketball sections in Europe
Roig Arena · Fuente de San Luis Pavilion

items.title: Golf · Mediterranean courses
items.body: The province of Valencia has more than 15 golf courses, many of them with views of the Mediterranean and excellent weather all year round. Club de Golf El Saler, in the Albufera Natural Park, is considered one of the best public courses in Europe. Golf La Sella, in Dénia, and Club de Golf Escorpión are other top-level options.
facts: A public course designed by Javier Arana next to the Albufera Natural Park
A private 18-hole course with top-level facilities north of Valencia

Province of Valencia · 30 min from the centre

items.title: Triathlon and IRONMAN
items.body: Valencia is one of the great triathlon destinations in Spain. The IRONMAN 70.3 Valencia takes place every April, combining swimming in La Marina, cycling around the city and running through the Turia Gardens. In June, the MTRI Valencia Triathlon takes over Malvarrosa beach. The climate, the infrastructure and the routes make Valencia an ideal city for any triathlete.

June at Malvarrosa, coinciding with the Gay Games 2026

blocks.title: Tips for playing sport in Valencia
items: The Turia Gardens are the best urban circuit for running or cycling, free and car-free
The Valencia Marathon (6 Dec) needs registration well in advance: it sells out in hours
Valenbisi has 250+ stations: the most convenient system for getting around the city by bike
Valencia’s beaches are ideal for surfing and paddleboarding from May to October
Club de Golf El Saler is a public course: you don’t need to be a member to play
Valencia Basket tickets at the Roig Arena sell out for EuroLeague games
